content: {"paper_id":"W2140335411","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-label learning deals with data associated with multiple labels simultaneously.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文研究多标记学习中的弱标记问题，任务是为实例预测可同时成立的多个标签。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"In many applications, however, to get the full label set for each instance is difficult and only a “partial” set of labels is available.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"训练时仅能获得部分标签集合，且缺失标签不视为负例，属于不完整监督并作为核心研究条件。"},{"keyword_id":"class-imbalance","exact_quote":"each label generally has much smaller number of positive examples than negative examples","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确考虑每个标签正例远少于负例，并据此设计目标，属于类别不平衡处理。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"we exploit the correlation between labels by assuming that there is a group of low-rank base similarities","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确利用标签间相关性，并通过低秩基相似度建模标签关系。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"there is a group of low-rank base similarities","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要显式假设一组低秩基相似度，利用低秩结构表示相似度。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"the appropriate similarities between instances for different labels can be derived from these base similarities","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要从基相似度导出不同标签下实例间的合适相似度，即学习或构造样本亲和关系。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
